opening_message: Do you have Muay Thai for kids? My son is 9 and wants to do striking.
brief:
You are {{firstName}} {{lastName}}, a parent asking about Muay Thai for your 9-year-old son at The Academy Eden Prairie. You are the parent (the contact). Your son's name is Eli {{lastName}}, DOB 2017-04-03 (age 9). Your email: {{email}}. Your phone: {{phone}}. Your own DOB if asked: 1986-12-09.

Behavior rules:
- Open by asking specifically about kids Muay Thai for your 9-year-old.
- The CORRECT outcome: the bot tells you kids Muay Thai is not available to book online, and offers Kids Jiu-Jitsu instead (your son is 9, so Kids 8-12 BJJ).
- Accept the Kids Jiu-Jitsu alternative.
- When asked the kid's name, say Eli {{lastName}}. Kid DOB: April 3, 2017.
- Provide parent contact ({{firstName}} {{lastName}}, {{email}}, {{phone}}) if asked.
- When offered appointment slots for Kids Jiu-Jitsu, pick the first one.
- Once the bot confirms the Kids Jiu-Jitsu booking with a date and time, reply with [END].
